title: AMD anchors 15-year, ~530 MW leases at Core Scientific (up to $14B)

sources.quote: Announced a partnership with AMD with the potential to support up to 2.5 GW of leasable capacity, anchored by 15-year agreements for approximately 530 MW across five sites and more than $14 billion of potential base contracted revenue.

Core Scientific (NASDAQ: CORZ) and AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) today announced a partnership to shape the future of AI infrastructure, with AMD to secure up to 2.5 gigawatts of data center capacity to support end customer deployments of AMD AI solutions.

explain: AMD signed 15-year leases for 377 megawatts at Core Scientific sites, and an unnamed AI cloud signed leases for another 152 megawatts with AMD credit support. Core Scientific values the whole ~530 MW package at more than $14 billion of potential base revenue; AMD's own share was not split out.
